parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: The setting
steps.prompt: What is the setting of a story?
steps.hint: Home, school and the park can be settings.
steps.explanation: The setting is where the story happens.
steps.shortExplanation: The setting is where the story happens.

steps.title: Ruby's Worry
steps.prompt: Ruby's Worry got smaller when she … about it.
steps.hint: What did she do with her new friend?
steps.explanation: Ruby talked about her Worry, and it got smaller.
steps.shortExplanation: Ruby talked about her Worry, and it got smaller.

steps.title: Stomped and grumbled
steps.prompt: Katie Morag stomped and grumbled. How did she feel?
steps.hint: How do you walk when you are cross?
steps.explanation: Stomping and grumbling show that Katie Morag was cross.
steps.shortExplanation: Stomping and grumbling show that Katie Morag was cross.

steps.title: More than one fox
steps.hint: Fox ends with x, like box.
steps.explanation: Fox ends with x, so two foxes. Box works the same: boxes.
steps.shortExplanation: Fox ends with x, so two foxes. Box works the same: boxes.

steps.title: Clap elephant
steps.prompt: How many syllables are in elephant?
steps.explanation: El-e-phant has three claps, so it has 3 syllables.
steps.shortExplanation: El-e-phant has three claps, so it has 3 syllables.

steps.title: Find the adjective
steps.prompt: The golden crocodile swims. Which word is the adjective?
steps.hint: Which word tells us what the crocodile is like?
steps.explanation: Golden describes the crocodile, so it is the adjective.
steps.shortExplanation: Golden describes the crocodile, so it is the adjective.

steps.title: Rhymes with goat
steps.explanation: Goat and boat both end with oat, so they rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Goat and boat both end with oat, so they rhyme.

source.answerKeyText: stoat (or boat, coat if he says any rhyming word — give the mark)

steps.title: The back cover
steps.prompt: The words on the back cover that tell you what a book is about are the…
steps.hint: Turn a book over and read it.
steps.explanation: The blurb is on the back cover and tells you what the book is about.
steps.shortExplanation: The blurb is on the back cover and tells you what the book is about.

steps.title: Refill the bottle
steps.hint: You use the same bottle again.
steps.explanation: Refilling the same bottle is reuse: using it again.
steps.shortExplanation: Refilling the same bottle is reuse: using it again.

steps.title: How long is a label?
steps.prompt: Is a label usually one or two words, or a long sentence?
steps.hint: Labels are tiny and point with a line.
steps.explanation: A label is usually one or two words.
steps.shortExplanation: A label is usually one or two words.

goalActivities.text: Name the setting of your favourite cartoon together. Could a story happen in your kitchen?
goalActivities.textAr: قولوا مكان أحداث الكارتون اللي بتحبوه مع بعض. ممكن قصة تحصل في مطبخكم؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Have a short "talk about it" time at bedtime: each of you says one small worry and one happy thing.
goalActivities.textAr: خلّوا فيه وقت قصير قبل النوم "نتكلم عنها": كل واحد يقول حاجة صغيرة قلقاه وحاجة فرّحته.

goalActivities.text: Act out feeling verbs and guess the feeling: stomp (cross), skip (happy), tiptoe (scared).
goalActivities.textAr: مثّلوا أفعال مشاعر وخمّنوا الإحساس: stomp (متضايق)، skip (مبسوط)، tiptoe (خايف).
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Find words that end in x together: box, fox, six. Say two of each: two boxes, two foxes.
goalActivities.textAr: دوّروا على كلمات آخرها x مع بعض: box و fox و six. وقولوا اتنين من كل واحدة: two boxes و two foxes.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Clap the names of animals at the zoo or in a book: el-e-phant, gi-raffe, li-on.
goalActivities.textAr: صقفوا أسامي الحيوانات في جنينة الحيوانات أو في كتاب: el-e-phant و gi-raffe و li-on.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Say a sentence about an animal and your child adds a describing word: The ___ lion roars.
goalActivities.textAr: قول جملة عن حيوان وطفلك يزوّد كلمة وصف: The ___ lion roars.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Make an oat rhyme chain together: goat, boat, coat, float, stoat. How long can you go?
goalActivities.textAr: اعملوا سلسلة قوافي oat مع بعض: goat و boat و coat و float و stoat. توصلوا لحد فين؟

goalActivities.text: Write a one-sentence blurb together for your child's favourite book.
goalActivities.textAr: اكتبوا مع بعض نبذة من جملة واحدة للكتاب اللي طفلك بيحبه.

goalActivities.text: Give your child a water bottle of their own to refill each day. Each time, say: we are reusing it!
goalActivities.textAr: ادّي طفلك إزازة مية بتاعته يملاها كل يوم، وكل مرة قولوا: we are reusing it!

goalActivities.text: Label things in your child's room with sticky notes: bed, door, window. One or two words each!
goalActivities.textAr: حطّوا ورق لاصق بأسامي الحاجات في أوضة طفلك: bed و door و window. كلمة أو كلمتين بس لكل واحدة!

homeActivities.text: Look again at any question your child found hard and play that unit's home game once more, then try again in a week.
